name: SFA Semicon Co., Ltd.
summary: SFA Semicon Co., Ltd. provides semiconductor packaging, assembly, testing, and inspection services in South Korea and internationally. The company offers packaging products, including fan-out wafer level packages, chip-on-chip and chip-on-wafer packages, flip-chip products, laminate packages, lead-frame packages, micro secure digital cards, secure digital cards, solid-state drives, and bumping products. It also provides turn-key processing, wafer and final testing services, back-end semiconductor services comprising laser marking, visual and mechanical inspection, baking, tape-and-reel, and dry-packing services, as well as test engineering and customized test-data IT services.
